name: Raising Canes West Tropicana

sources.observed: Official address 3535 West Tropicana, C0439 and drive-through.

December 2022 site-specific Street View inspected: beige/grey stucco, rough stone plinth, raised entrance with cap, silver-framed door/window, dark sloping ribbed metal awning, shrubs and drive-through to west. Brand listing lead photo is different and must not drive geometry.

Aerial confirms narrow north-south building east of bank and west of McDonalds. Photo CIABIhDs24rdcrdBufP9yNP2jZDT by Alejandro Esqueda April 2026 shows red entrance panel, stone veneer and silver double doors; reconcile with older site view. Photo CIABIhDmW1zemmgkMOY_1Aw3S9mx by Mirza Daniyal Ahmad November 2025 shows black booths, brown tables, rough brick walls and white pendants; layout only partial. Lead brand photo CIHM0ogKEICAgIC1staMWA December 2023 differs materially from site panorama.
